summary: Western Digital filed an 8-K reporting privately negotiated exchange agreements with holders of its 3.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2028. Holders agreed to exchange approximately $191.0 million aggregate principal for about $192.7 million cash (principal plus accrued interest) plus common stock equal to remaining conversion value based on the August 26, 2026 VWAP. Exempt under Section 4(a)(2). Expected close on or after September 2, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor named. This is a liability-management transaction, essentially an issuer tender of convertible notes. Watch for settlement terms, potential dilution from stock issuance, and accounting impact on debt extinguishment.
